Qingdao, China February 10, 2025 Factory Tour
Factory Tour

Client Factory Visit — Southeast Asia

Hosted a group of Southeast Asian distributors for a comprehensive factory tour and product demonstration.

Event Overview

On February 10, 2025, HOLGENVY welcomed a delegation of distributors from across Southeast Asia to our manufacturing headquarters in Qingdao, China. The factory visit program was designed to give our partners an in-depth look at every stage of our production process — from raw material inspection to final product packaging — reinforcing the transparency and quality standards that define the HOLGENVY brand.

Clients from Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Philippines participated in this multi-day event, which combined facility tours, live product demonstrations, and strategic business discussions. In the hardware sourcing industry, face-to-face relationship building remains essential. Seeing production capabilities firsthand builds a level of trust and confidence that no catalog or video call can replicate, and it allows distributors to make more informed decisions about the products they bring to their local markets.

Highlights

  • 12 distributor representatives attended from 4 countries
  • Toured 3 production lines across the manufacturing facility
  • Visited the QC lab and R&D center for in-depth technical review
  • Hands-on product testing session with the latest tool lineup
  • Signed 2 agency agreements during the visit

Facility Tour

The production facility tour provided a comprehensive walkthrough of HOLGENVY's manufacturing operations. Guests observed the motor assembly line, where high-performance brushless motors are wound, balanced, and tested to precise tolerances. The injection molding workshop showcased our automated tool housing production, with real-time quality monitoring at every station. In the battery pack assembly area, distributors saw the cell matching, welding, and protection circuit installation processes that ensure safe and reliable power delivery. The tour concluded at the final quality inspection station, where every finished tool undergoes a multi-point checklist before packaging and shipment.

Product Demonstration

Following the facility tour, HOLGENVY's technical team conducted live demonstrations of the core product range. Distributors tested brushless drills under load, experienced the power and precision of impact wrenches on calibrated fasteners, and operated angle grinders through extended cutting sessions. The demonstration included torque testing on a digital measurement rig, battery runtime tests under continuous high-draw conditions, and side-by-side durability comparisons with competing brands. These hands-on sessions allowed each participant to evaluate real-world performance and ask detailed technical questions directly to our engineering staff.

Client Feedback

Feedback from the attending distributors was overwhelmingly positive. Clients praised the visible quality control processes throughout the factory, noting that the rigorous inspection standards gave them strong confidence in product reliability for their end users. Several distributors highlighted the professional packaging and branding options as a key differentiator for their local markets. The after-sales support framework — including warranty processing, spare parts availability, and technical training resources — was also commended as a critical factor in their decision to deepen the partnership with HOLGENVY.

Next Steps

Building on the momentum of this successful visit, HOLGENVY is planning follow-up trips to key markets in Thailand and Vietnam to provide on-the-ground support for product launches and distributor training. Two customization projects were initiated during the visit — one for region-specific voltage configurations and another for localized packaging designs — and our R&D team has already begun development. We look forward to continuing these partnerships and welcoming more distributors to Qingdao in the coming months.
